QuestInfo.name: Finally Open! Cross World Party Quest
QuestInfo.0: Spiegelette has something to say about the party quests... What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: The many Maple worlds are merging... And now they're merging party quests between worlds, too! That means you can rock party quests with friends in other worlds... Finally, right? Use the #b#p9010022# to go to #m910002000##k. You hope #p9076000# will give you more details...
QuestInfo.2: You learned about Cross World Party Quests. There will be a new merged party quest every two weeks. You should go try it out now.

0.0: Party quests with friends are the best when you're ready to go whole hog. Now you can even party with #rfriends in different worlds#k!

yes.0: Now we're talking! Use the #b#p9010022# in towns to go to #m910002000##k!
yes.1: You can also use the 'Quick Move' button at the top left of the towns. Hurry up, buckaroo!

no.0: No? C'mon, man. Come visit me if you ever change your mind. The Cross World Party Quest is always waiting for you!

0.1: So, do you want to visit the party quest wait map?

yes.0: You know all about the wild party quests you can get into here, right?
yes.1: Well, you can play new Cross World Party Quests every week! Isn't that cool, teaming up with heroes from across time and space and servers and stuff?
yes.2: Keep using Cross World Party Quests and you'll get great items and EXP! Keep rocking, buddy!
